newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel says three soldiers killed in Lebanon.
newsitem.headline: Israel says three soldiers killed in Lebanon.

text.p: Three Israeli soldiers were killed and one wounded in an explosion in south Lebanon early on Thursday, an army spokeswoman said.
The army said the pro-Iranian Hizbollah group took responsibility for the explosive charge in the Shoumariyyeh area inside Israel's south Lebanon occupation zone.

Military censors barred publication of the incident for hours until the families of the casualties were informed. Pro-Israeli militia sources reported the incident on Thursday before the Israeli army officially confirmed it.

"Three Israeli soldiers were killed and another suffered medium wounds last night around midnight from an explosive charge during an active patrol in the central sector of the security zone," the army statement said.

"The IDF force on an active patrol in the Shoumariyyeh area in the central sector went over an explosive charge. Three soldiers were killed and one was wounded and evacuated to hospital. Hizbollah took responsibility for the incident."
Israel patrols a south Lebanese border zone along with its South Lebanon Army militia allies.
